docTitle: Map amada Bāibal · Bāibalbu Scroll Amada
metaDesc: Ariba Wārepnabagi matam-lambi, Jisugi punsi, amasung Paul-gi khongchatsing achumba map amada inthou — Bāibaldi achumba maphamsingda thokkhibani.

s.title: Map amada Bāibal
s.verse: “Maramdi eikhoina nakhoida eikhoigi Ibungo Jisu Khristagi pānggalgi amasung mahākna lengbirakpagi maramda hāiba matamda, mioibagi lousingna semjin sājinba wārigi matung inna hāikhide, adubu eikhoidi mahākki matik chāoba adugi sākhisingni.” (2 Peter 1:16)
s.purpose: Bāibaldi lallaba wākhal natte. Masi achumba mapham, tārikh amasung mingsingda khongliba misinggi khonthāngni. Lambising adu map amagi mathakta, matamgi lambida inthou — mapham amada thintou, nattraga ▶ namduna chāng-chāngna khongthou.
s.ot_lead: Khongchat amakhak natte adubu semtibadagi houba kanbibagi itihāsgi chenba adu: semtiba amasung tāba → ising ichāo amasung Babel → kouba (Abraham) → wāsaktaba lam → Ijip thadoktuna lamhāngda → lamhāng → maithokpa → ningthou leibāk → khaidokpa → mināi oina puthokpa → halakpa.
s.je_lead: Aphaba Pāo mari-na haiba maongda, matamgi lambida Jisugi punsi adu inthou — Bethlehem-da pokpadagi houraga baptize amasung Galilee thougal, Samaria phāraga, Jerusalem-gi kros, hingatpa amasung kāthokpa faoba.
s.pa_lead: Jerusalem-gi Pentecost-tagi, Aphaba Pāona Judea-gi wangmada karamna sandokkhibage — Asia Minor amasung Europe phāraga leibāk achoubagi thamoi faoba. Khongchat mangāgi maraktagi ama khandou (1·2·3 + Rome-da hi-na chatpa + thadokkhraba tungda) aduga lambida iriba chitthisingga loinana Pāothokpagi thoudoksing inthou.
s.foot: Houphamsing · Maphamsingdi Bāibalgi wārol amasung Bāibalgi khang-nairaba bhugolgi matung inna (kānnaba maphamda houjikki mingga loinana) oi. Torban, turel amasung pātsingdi hāngdokpa bhugolgi data (Natural Earth)-dagi lou-i, laibana onthok-i.

eden.name: Eden (Semtiba · Tāba)
eden.note: Yāmna phaba oina semkhraba taibangpan amada, pāp changlaktuna Isor amasung mioibagi marak thugai-i.
events: Numit taruktagi semtiba — “yāmna phaba”
Mioibabu Isorgi mitamda sembiba
Tāba, aduga Edendagi tanthokpa

noah.name: Ararat (Ising Ichāo)
noah.today: houjikki nongpok thangba Türkiye-gi Ararat ching
noah.note: Isorna pāpna thanba taibangpan amabu wāyel-i, adubu imung amagi mapānna hingba adu ngāk-senbi.

Ising ichāo, aduga Noah-gi hi

babel.name: Babel-gi Tower
babel.note: Swargada youningba napalgi mai-onda, Isorna makhoigi lon amasung misingbu malemgi mathakta chaithok-i.
events: “Eikhoina sahar ama amasung tower ama sāsi… aduga eikhoigidamak maming ama loujasi”
Isorna makhoigi lon adu changnahalli
Misingna malemgi mathakta chaithokle (Shinar — tungda Babylon)

ur.name: Ur
ur.note: Bāibalgi kanbibagi wāri asi mi amabu koubadagi houi.
events: Isorna Kaldia-gi Ur-dagi Abram-bu kou-i
“eina nahākpu achouba jāti ama oihan'gani… na'ngonda mālemgi imung manung pumnamak bor phangjagani”
Thājabagi mapānna mahākna mahākki lam thadok-i

haran.name: Haran
haran.note: Lambida, wāsaktaba lam adugi maikeida koubada paokhum piduna.
events: Terah-gi imung Haran-da leire
Terah sī-i
Chahi 75 surabada Abram Kanāan-da chatnaba thok-i

shechem.name: Shechem · Kanāan
shechem.note: Wāsaktaba lamda imung ama lep-i aduga warepnaba adu dhārā mathang mathang chatthari.

Jākobki machā taranithoi — salai taranithoigi maru

egypt.note: Imung ama achouba jāti ama oirakle — adudagi mināigi jāti ama.
events: Yonkhraba Joseph, Ijip pānba faoba thanggatlak-i
Chāk tāngba nāmdaba nanaba Jākobki imung apumba kumtharak-i
Chāokhatlakpa Isrāyelgi jāti adu mināi oihalli

sinai.name: Sinai Ching
sinai.note: Ariba Wārepnabagi maru oiba kanbiba — mināising Isorgi masāgi mi oirakle.
events: Awāba potlum tara amasung Lanthengbagi yāo machā

Wāyel Yāthang Tara, Wāyel, Isorgi yumsang amasung katchabasing

kadesh.name: Kadesh (lamhāng)
kadesh.note: Thājadabana dhārā amagi lam adu manghalli — adubu Isor makhoiga leiminni.
events: Lānmi taranithoi — adubu misingna thājaba yāde
Turphānda chahi 38 — manna, leichil amasung mei
Moab-gi tampakta, Mousi-gi aroiba pāo (Deuteronomy)

jericho.name: Jericho
jericho.note: Aroibada makhoina wāsaktaba lam adu changduna lou-i.
events: Jordan khāidoktuna misingna lanthok-i
Jericho-gi kheng-pāl tā-i
Kanāan maithokpa amasung lam yenthokpa

shiloh.name: Shiloh (Wāyel Mapusing)
shiloh.note: Ningthou leitaba, mi khudingna māgi mityengda chumba tou-i — achumba ningthou ama mathou tā-i.
events: Isorgi yumsang adu Shiloh-da lep-i
pāp–namphuba–kanbiba haibagi chak-haba (Deborah, Gideon, Samson)

jerusalem.name: Jerusalem · Punsinba Leibāk
jerusalem.note: Isrāyelgi maming chāoba matam — aduga lomba nāidaba ningthou amagi wāsak.
events: Ahānba ningthou Saul, adudagi David amasung Goliath
David-gi warepnaba — “nahākki phambān matam pumnamakki oina” (2 Samuel 7)
Solomon-na Jerusalemda Sanglen sā-i

samaria.name: Samaria · Khaidoklaba Leibāk
samaria.note: Wā tākthokpasingna lāoringeida, leibāk adu khaiduna hanthari.

Amuk amuk lāi murti latpa
Elijah, Isaiah, Jeremiah-na ‘hallak'u’ haina lao-i — aduga Messiah adu laothok-i

nineveh.name: Nineveh (Assyria)
nineveh.note: Cheksin khuding indaduna, awāng thangba adu hanna tā-i.
events: Assyria-gi ningthamlen Nineveh
Awāng-thangba leibāk adu Assyria-da tā-i (B.C. 722)
Jonah-bu Nineveh-da thā-i

babylon.name: Babylon
babylon.note: Khwāidagi amamba ahing — adubu amuk semgatpagi wāsak adu leihouri.
events: Jerusalem tā-i, Sanglen mei chāk-i (B.C. 586)
Judah-bu Babylon-da puthok-i
Daniel amasung Ezekiel — mināi oiribada thājaba amasung uhanbisings

susa.name: Susa (Persia)
susa.note: Lāi ningdaba leibāk achouba amagi thamoidasu, Isorna mahākki misingbu ngāk-senbi.

Esther-na Jihudising adu mangtaktagi kanbi
Nehemiah-na ningthou-gi māngda haijaraga thā-i

return.name: Jerusalemda Halakpa
return.note: Makhoi halaklaga amuk sā-i — adubu ningthou amata lāktri. Makhoina Messiah adu ngaii.
events: Cyrus-gi yāthangna halakpa tāram ahum (Zerubbabel 538 · Ezra 458 · Nehemiah 444)
Sanglen amuk sā-i aduga Jerusalemgi kheng-pāl amuk semgat-i
Malachi — Ariba Wārepnaba loi-i: “eina eigi pāo puba mi thāri”

bethlehem.name: Bethlehem
bethlehem.note: Wāsaktaba Messiah adu David-gi sahar-da lāk-i — Wāhei adu hakchang oirakle.

Swargadutsingna yāosenbasingda pāo adu laothok-i
Lousing heiba misingna khurumnaba lāk-i

nazareth.name: Nazareth
nazareth.note: Isorna nemba sahar amada mi ama oina chāokhat-i.
events: U-shu-gi yumda chāokhat-i
Chahi taranithoida, Sanglenda hangba amasung paokhum piba
Tungda mahākki sahar-gi synagogue-da yātte

jordan.name: Jordan Turel
jordan.note: Mahākki miyāmgi thougal houi — swargana mahākpu Machānipā oina utpi.

Thawāi adu khunu amagumna kumtharak-i — “Mahāk eigi nungsijaraba ichā nipāni”

cana.name: Cana
cana.note: Mahākki ahānba khudam aduda mahākki matik mangāl adu utpi.

sychar.note: Ahouba thougalgi lambi — Jerusalem phāraga yānthiba Samaria faoba.
events: Mahākna Jerusalem-gi Sanglen adu sengdok-i

Samaria-gi nupi amagidamak hingba ising

capernaum.name: Capernaum
capernaum.note: Galilee thougalgi yumpham — kouba, tāmbiba amasung yekpa pumnamak mapham asida unare.

Ching-gi mathakki pāo — “Thawāida tonbasing adu yāiphabani”
Ningthou leibākki pāndam wāri — aduga hengatlakpa yekpa

galilee.name: Galilee Pāt
galilee.note: Prakritigi mathakta pānggalna mahākna kanā oiribage haibadu utpi.

caesarea_p.name: Caesarea Philippi
caesarea_p.note: Mahāk Khristani haibadu tung-inbasingna khang-i, aduga krosgi lambi hāng-i.
events: Peter-gi haidokpa — “Nahāk Khrista, ahingba Isorgi Machānipāni”

jericho.name: Jericho
jericho.note: Jerusalem-da kāba lambida, mahākna mangkhrabasingbu thi.

Kanggat khomba Zacchaeus-bu kou-i
“Migi Machānipā aduna māngkhraba adubu thiba amasung kanbiba lākle”

bethany.name: Bethany
bethany.note: Mahākki aroiba chayolgi mamāngda mahākna sibagi mathakta mapānggal utpi.

jerusalem.name: Jerusalem
jerusalem.note: Bāibal apumbana takliba aroiba mapham — kros, hingatpa, kāthokpa.
events: Māyokna changba; mahākna Sanglengi table adu amuk onthok-i
Aroiba Chākkhāramda mahākna tung-inbasinggi khong hamdok-i

Numit ahumsuba numitta hingatlaga, adudagi kāthok-i

antioch.name: Antioch
antioch.note: Jentilgi thougal houba amasung halakpa thāba sang-lup.
events: Haijaringeida Thawāi-na Barnabas amasung Saul-bu khaidok-i
thājabasingbu ahānba oina ‘Christian’ haina koukhiba sang-lup
Ahānba, anisuba amasung ahumsuba khongchatki houpham

seleucia.name: Seleucia
seleucia.note: Antioch-gi port — makhoina Cyprus-ta hi-na chatnaba thok-i.

salamis.name: Salamis (Cyprus)
salamis.note: Cyprus-ki ahānba lep-pham — synagogue-sing-da pāo sandokpa.

paphos.name: Paphos

Leingākpa Sergius Paulus-na thāje
Mapham asidagi ‘Paul’-na luchingba houi

perga.name: Perga
perga.note: Pamphylia-gi port ama — mapham asida John Mark hanjare.

pantioch.name: Pisidia-gi Antioch
events: Synagogue-da kanbibagi itihāsgi sāngba pāo ama

iconium.name: Iconium
iconium.note: Mi kayāna thāje, adubu otpi neibana makhoibu mamāngda chatthahalli.

lystra.note: Lāi ama oina thāgatlaga, adudagi nungna thā-i.

philippi.note: Europe-gi ahānba sang-lup — keisumsangdasu Aphaba Pāo māyokna maithi-i.
events: Angouba phi yonba nupi Lydia-na thāje
Maithoi yengba mināi nupimacha amabu ningtamhalli

thess.name: Thessalonica
thess.note: Wāhei-na sahar adu nikhalli aduga yekpa adu wangkhatlak-i.

“Tāibangpānbu mathak makhā onhanba mising adu”

berea.name: Berea
berea.note: wāhei adu makhoi masāna cheksinkhiba ‘maminglaba’ misingsing.

Madu chānglabra haina numit khuding sāstra adu cheksin-i

athens.name: Athens

ephesus.name: Ephesus
ephesus.note: Ahumsuba khongchatki thamoi — wāhei-na Asia sinba thungna sandok-i.

miletus.name: Miletus
events: “mahāk masāmakki eena leibikhraba sang-lup adu senbiyu”

caesarea.name: Caesarea
caesarea.note: Chahi ani leingākpasing amasung ningthou ama-gi māngda mahākna Aphaba Pāo ngākchei.
events: Leingākpa Felix amasung Festus-ki māngda wāyenba
Ningthou Agrippa-gi māngda mahākki ngākchaba
“Eina Keisārda wākatchari” — Rome-da

jerusalem.name: Jerusalem
jerusalem.note: Sanglenda pham-i, mahākki phātpa oibagi lambi houi.

Sanglup-ki māngda masāna ngākchei

myra.name: Myra
myra.note: Makhoina Rome-da chatkadaba Alexandria-gi hi amada onsille.

maral leitaba, thājaba yāba luchingbasingbu kou-i

puteoli.name: Puteoli

rome.name: Rome
rome.note: Aroibada Aphaba Pāona leibāk achouba adugi thamoi youre — aroiba natte adubu houba amani.
